decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Before the rebuilt shed is constructed, samples of patterned brickwork to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council and then implemented in accordance with approved samples.

Condition : 5 - Before the rebuilt shed is first utilised, full details of the proposed remedial treatment to the original boundary walls shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council and then implemented in accordance with approved scheme.
Condition : 6 - The existing shad shall be demolished within six months of the date of this permission to allow the construction of the new shed hereby approved.
description: Retention of detached garden shed at rear of dwellinghouse.
